sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO ICOMCOD1 A USING ( SELECT 'MP-A' AS TYPE, #SELLER_ITEM_NO# AS CODE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.TYPE = B.TYPE AND A.CODE = B.CODE ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TYPE, CODE, TEXT1, TEXT2, FLAG, ADD_DATE ) VALUES ( B.TYPE, #SELLER_ITEM_NO#, TRIM(#CLOSE_CODE#), TRIM(#NOTE#), 'T', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TEXT1 = TRIM(#CLOSE_CODE#) , TEXT2 = TRIM(#NOTE#), ADD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), FLAG = DECODE(TEXT1, TRIM(#CLOSE_CODE#), FLAG, 'T' )
